chunks: And if your Lord had willed, all those on earth would have believed entirely. So will you compel the people until they become believers?
ai.seo_question: Why didn't God make everyone believe if He could?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the principle of *Ikhtiyar* (free will), affirming that faith must be a voluntary choice rather than a coerced obligation, which validates the Prophet's role as a warner (*Nadhir*) rather than a ruler over hearts. It is often cited to refute the Qadariyyah and Mu'tazilah extremes, establishing a balanced view where divine decree (*Qada*) coexists with human agency. This reinforces the theological basis for the Imamate, where Imams guide through wisdom and example, not compulsion.
